task:
FINDER F4b, PART 3g: THREE VISUAL DEFECTS IN THE FLAG-ON RESULTS PANEL. Work on this branch only (feat/finder-f4b, now at 6b1dd01f). Keep the change small and limited to what is described here.

BACKGROUND. The reviewer ran the Product E2E journey locally on 6b1dd01f with VITE_FINDER_F4_ENABLED=1 (all four tests pass) and reviewed the captured screenshots finder-any and finder-flexible at 1280x800 and 390x844. The cards, picker, fit label, Inspect page and map look right and match the design. Three things in the results panel of ExploreWorkspace.svelte do not:

1. Grammar. The live status line renders `{displayedResults.page.count} results on this page.`, so a one-row page reads "1 results on this page." Use the singular for exactly one row ("1 result on this page.") and the plural otherwise ("0 results", "3 results"). Do not change the design-specified summary "Showing COUNT of TOTAL (results START–END)" in FinderResultRanking.svelte; it follows design section "Loading, empty and error states".

2. Alignment. The `.ranking-status` line and the `<nav class="result-paging" aria-label="Result pages">` sit flush against the left border of the results panel (x≈17 px at 1280 wide), while the panel heading above and the result cards are inset by about 1 rem. Give both the same horizontal inset as the panel content around them (use the existing panel heading/card padding values rather than a new magic number), and give the paging row a little space below it so it does not touch the panel's bottom edge. Check both 1280x800 and 390x844; nothing may overflow horizontally.

3. Paging buttons. Previous and Next render as plain unstyled text, and the disabled one looks the same as the enabled one. Give both buttons the app's existing `quiet-button` class (apps/web/src/app.css already styles it, including `.quiet-button:disabled` at reduced opacity with a not-allowed cursor), so they match the Pin/Compare/Watch buttons and the disabled state is visible. Keep their text, order, disabled logic and click handlers unchanged.

TESTS. Add focused unit tests in apps/web (ExploreWorkspace.test.ts or a nearby existing test file) for: the singular/plural status text for 1 and for more than 1 row; and both paging buttons carrying `quiet-button` while the disabled one is disabled. Do not change the Cypress specs unless a selector there depends on the old markup (it should not: they use `[aria-label="Result pages"] button`).

VALIDATION. In apps/web: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`, and eslint/prettier on the files you touched. Run `python -m pytest -q tests/test_v3_product_journey_contract.py tests/test_review_lab_v3.py tests/test_e2e_harness_contract.py`. Add a sentence for this to the existing 2026-11-01 F4b CHANGES.md entry only if the entry describes the results-panel layout; otherwise leave CHANGES.md alone. Report every changed line in the .svelte files.
